name: Visa de Países Amigos (Friendly Nations Visa)

requirement_groups.name: Employment contract with a Panamanian company

requirements.blocker_text: Requires an active employment agreement with a Panamanian company, plus nationality from one of the ~44 qualifying 'friendly nations'.
Requires Panamanian real property with a registered value of at least USD 200,000 (may be locally financed), plus qualifying nationality.
Requires a certificate of deposit of at least USD 200,000 in a Panamanian national bank, held for a minimum 3-year term, plus qualifying nationality.
requirements.fix_path: Fund and document the qualifying fixed-term deposit.

evidence_required.document: Category-specific documentation (employment contract, property deed, or CD certificate)

outcome.duration_length: 2-year provisional residency, then eligible for permanent residency (each stage ~6 months processing)

sources.title: Kraemer & Kraemer (immigration law firm) -- Panama Friendly Nations Visa: three routes (employment/real estate/deposit), USD 200,000 thresholds, 44 qualifying countries, 2-year provisional to permanent timeline

Ministerio de Trabajo y Desarrollo Laboral de Panamá -- Permiso de Trabajo Países Amigos: 3-year provisional work permit, renewable, 9 Social Security contributions or tax filings required for renewal
Servicio Nacional de Migración de Panamá -- Permisos Migratorios overview, confirming a 'specific nationalities' special-policy permanent-resident category

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Panama's initial build.
